messages:
maya: Hi team, first-day onboarding: VPN shows connected but I can't reach bastion.redwood.internal or pull images from registry.redwood.internal:5000. Any quick checks?

it-bot: Welcome @maya! Tagging @harper (IT) and @netops. Onboarding doc: https://internal.redwood/onboarding/vpn-access

harper: Hey Maya, are you on company laptop or BYOD and which VPN client/version?

maya: BYOD MacBook, macOS 14.4, client VoltVPN 1.8. Client UI says "split tunnel".

netops: Run `netstat -rn | grep 10.` and `scutil --dns`. If there are no 10.* routes or corporate DNS, it's split-tunnel not pushing.

maya: `netstat` shows no 10 routes, `scutil --dns` shows Home ISP DNS.

harper: Quick workaround: enable "Route all traffic" in VoltVPN prefs and restart. If that fixes it, we'll push 10.30/10.31 prefixes to your profile.

maya: Tried route-all + restart -> still can't resolve bastion. `dig bastion.redwood.internal @10.30.0.10` times out.

netops: Ok we'll open a 20m firewall exception for your IP and allow SSH via public jump. Use `ssh -J maya@jump.pub.redwood ubuntu@10.30.4.2`. Also try lowering MTU `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1400` if TLS hangs.

maya: SSH via jump works after firewall rule. Docker pull hangs at TLS handshake; `curl -v` shows cert CN=registry.internal not registry.redwood.

harper: That's a cert SAN mismatch. Short term connect to registry IP `https://10.30.4.3:5000`, we'll rotate certs to include registry.redwood. I also requested push of 10.30/10.31 routes and DNS for VoltVPN profile (ticket ONB-5322).

netops: Routes/DNS pushed; restart client in ~2m.

maya: Restarted, routes present, DNS resolves, SSH and docker pull by name work. Thanks everyone!

harper: Welcome aboard! We'll add a BYOD checklist item to onboarding: client version, `netstat` output, public IP for faster triage. Company laptop recommended to avoid client quirks.

maya: Great, appreciate the help :)
